description: Renovate opens and updates PRs only on Monday mornings: every PR update re-runs CI, and the org has 3,000 Actions minutes a month. Security updates are not scheduled. When merging one Renovate PR leaves another behind master, tick its rebase checkbox: manual rebases ignore the schedule.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Monthly, not config:best-practices' weekly: each refresh is its own PR and CI run. Security updates still open immediately.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Put digest updates (pinned GitHub Actions and Docker images, from config:best-practices) in the weekly non-major PR instead of one PR each. First in the list, so the named groups below still claim their own digests.

Let a release sit before we propose it. config:best-practices only applies a cooldown to npm (security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm), and most of what we track is terraform providers, GitHub Action digests and .tool-versions releases. Security updates bypass this, and anything urgent can be forced from the Dependency Dashboard.
OpenTofu/Terraform version is governed by .tool-versions; do not bump required_version blocks independently.

Keep the whole Vite+ toolchain version in one PR: the `vp` pin in .tool-versions (github-releases voidzero-dev/vite-plus), the `vite-plus` npm devDep, and the `@voidzero-dev/vite-plus-core` package aliased by the `overrides.vite` entry. These are the same version expressed three ways; bumping them in separate PRs makes the standalone-vite/core Plugin types diverge (vp check TS2321/TS2769) and mismatches rolldown's native binding.

customManagers.description: bun via package.json `packageManager` field (Renovate's npm manager skips bun here — verified against renovate main 2026-05-20)
